The client (Li Jun, traveling as a couple for their 10th wedding anniversary) wants to go to New Zealand's South Island for 8 days departing from Shanghai. They have an open budget and have explicitly requested: a helicopter glacier experience, a private vineyard wine tasting, a boat charter through the fiords, and a supercar self-drive day. They prioritize privacy and the very best available options.

Please research available luxury options using the search tools at your disposal, then produce a full luxury travel dossier covering all required aspects (flights, accommodation, dining, exclusive experiences, budget breakdown, and pre-trip checklist). Save the final plan as: nz_luxury_plan_li_jun.md
